name: Hensai Seido
source:
Yasuomi is a loan shark. One day, he visits a house to collect money. It seems father is gone somewhere and there are only wife and her daughter. A while later, he finds that it is Fusae. She was his classmate. Though she doesn't like him, all she can do is to ask him to delay payment. He accepts it, but....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108041230/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009057]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
安臣是一名放高利贷的。某天，他上门收债。家里似乎只有妻子和女儿，父亲不知去了哪里。过了一会儿，他发现那是英佐——她曾是他的同学。虽然她不喜欢他，但她能做的只有请求延期还款。他答应了，但是……
